headline: Qualcomm lists Staff SerDes role spanning behavioral modeling, system verification, and silicon correlation
fact: Qualcomm Canada ULC listed a Cross-Functional Engineer, Staff role for high-speed SerDes work. The description assigns oversight of analog and mixed-signal behavioral-model development and verification, higher-abstraction analog verification, system verification with digital-verification and firmware teams, calibration, power modeling, and correlation of pre-silicon models and predicted power with post-silicon measurements. It asks for 106 Gbps-and-higher SerDes experience and SystemVerilog behavioral modeling, and names clock generation and distribution, VCOs, phase interpolators, PLLs, ADCs, and DACs among relevant circuit experience.
